helpBid: bid party <s>|betli|durchmarsch|ulti <s>  declare a contract (Party/Ulti take trump s/c/h/d)
helpDiscard: discard <i> <j>           discard 2 cards after taking the talon
promptBidHelp: bid party <s/c/h/d> ... Party  |  bid betli ... Betli  |  bid durchmarsch ... Durchmarsch  |  bid ulti <s/c/h/d> ... Ulti (win the last trick with the trump 7)
promptDiscardHelp: discard <i> <j> ... discard 2 unwanted cards face down
promptPlayHelp: play <idx> ... play a card (A>10>K>Q>J>9>8>7; must follow suit)
promptTrickEndHelp: n / next ... go to the next trick
promptRoundEndHelp: nr / nextround ... go to the next deal
hintReasonLeadHigh: You are declarer — lead a strong card to take control
hintReasonLeadLow: You are coalition — lead a low card to conserve
hintReasonFollowWin: You can win — take the trick
hintReasonDiscardLow: Cannot follow suit — discard a low card
hintReasonBidUlti: A long suit holding the trump 7 — declare Ulti
helpExampleNext: n                         read the trick result, then continue
helpExampleTalon: discard 0 1               put two cards back after taking the talon
